column1: 5.5.4.2.3.7 Save Emitter Library To Another File. User can save the selected
emitter library (with modifications, if any) to another file on SCD storage by clicking on
‘Save to Another File’ option on the GUI. A confirmation GUI, as shown in Figure 5.23, shall
be displayed to user. A file selection GUI shall be displayed to user for entering file name
& user shall click on ‘Save’ option to save.
